privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use
privacy_policy.section1_description: We value your privacy and want to be transparent about how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
privacy_policy.section1_description2: This Privacy Policy explains our data handling practices and your rights. By using the platform, you agree with the practices described in this document.
privacy_policy.section2_account_items:
• Full name
• Email address
• Password (encrypted)
• Avatar/Profile photo
• Profile information
privacy_policy.section2_activity_items:
• Typing history (tests performed)
• Performance results (speed, accuracy)
• Time spent on platform
• Progress in events and competitions
• Scores and rankings
privacy_policy.section2_technical_items:
• IP address
• Device type and browser
• Operating system
• Cookies and session data
• Approximate location (from IP)
privacy_policy.section2_third_party_intro: If you use social login (Google, GitHub), we will receive:
privacy_policy.section2_third_party_items:
• Unique third-party identifier
• Name and email
• Profile picture
• Email verification status
privacy_policy.section3_intro: Your data will be used for:
privacy_policy.section3_service_desc: Create and maintain your account, process typing tests, record results
privacy_policy.section3_personalization_desc: Adapt content and recommendations based on your performance and preferences
privacy_policy.section3_communication_desc: Send notifications about events, updates, and important messages (via email)
privacy_policy.section3_security_desc: Detect and prevent fraud, abusive behavior, and ensure platform security
privacy_policy.section3_analytics_desc: Understand how you use the platform and optimize user experience
privacy_policy.section3_compliance_desc: Comply with legal obligations and respond to legitimate requests from authorities
privacy_policy.section3_reports_desc: Generate aggregated and anonymous analyses to improve the service
privacy_policy.section4_intro: We do not sell your personal data. We may share it with:
privacy_policy.section4_providers_desc: Companies that help us operate the platform (hosting, analytics, email)
privacy_policy.section4_authorities_desc: If required by law or to protect rights and security
privacy_policy.section4_users_desc: Public data such as name, avatar, and scores in rankings/events (only what you shared)
privacy_policy.section4_successors_desc: In case of merger, acquisition, or asset sale
privacy_policy.section5_description: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction:
privacy_policy.section5_items:
• Data encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS)
• Encrypted passwords with secure algorithms
• Restricted access to personal data (principle of least privilege)
• Regular security audits
• Backups and continuity plans
privacy_policy.section5_note: Despite our security measures, no system is completely secure. Any breach will be communicated as required by law.
privacy_policy.section6_description: We maintain your data while your account is active and as required to comply with legal obligations:
privacy_policy.section6_account_data_desc: While the account exists, plus 30 days after deletion
privacy_policy.section6_activity_data_desc: For 2 years for analysis and audit
privacy_policy.section6_logs_desc: For 90 days for security and troubleshooting
privacy_policy.section7_intro: Under data protection legislation (GDPR), you have the following rights:
privacy_policy.section7_access_desc: Request a copy of your personal data
privacy_policy.section7_erasure_desc: Request deletion of your data (subject to legal exceptions)
privacy_policy.section7_portability_desc: Receive your data in a structured and common format
privacy_policy.section7_objection_desc: Object to processing of your data for certain purposes
privacy_policy.section7_automated: Right Not to Be Subject to Automated Decisions
privacy_policy.section7_automated_desc: Request human intervention in significant automated decisions
privacy_policy.section7_contact: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@NT.io
privacy_policy.section8_preferences_desc: Remember your chosen language and theme
privacy_policy.section8_footer: You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but some features may not work correctly.
privacy_policy.section9_description: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your data:
privacy_policy.section10_intro: By continuing to use this platform, you explicitly agree to:
privacy_policy.section10_item1: Collection and processing of your data as described in this policy
privacy_policy.section10_item2: Storage and protection of your data as described
privacy_policy.section10_item3: Sharing of data with selected service providers
privacy_policy.section10_item4: Use of cookies and tracking techniques
privacy_policy.section10_footer: You can revoke this consent at any time by deleting your account or contacting us. This does not affect the legality of prior processing.
privacy_policy.section11_description: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes by email or through a highlighted notice on the platform. Continued use of the platform after notification constitutes acceptance of the changes.
privacy_policy.disclaimer: This Privacy Policy is provided for informational purposes. In case of conflict between this policy and applicable law, applicable law prevails. For specific legal questions, consult a lawyer.
